[RDSC.5a.7e.3] `element_type` (the `SeriesElementType` enum)
distinguishes the slot value kind so `first` returns the correctly
typed value and `bool_*` apply only to `Bool` slots. Note the field
ordering: `element_type` takes tag 4, shifting `window_ns` / `persist_ns`
/ `max_samples` to tags 5 / 6 / 7 (unlike the other series backends,
where `window_ns` is tag 4).
